name: granite-native-frontend-worker
description: Contract-protected WinUI 3/C#/XAML frontend design, implementation, accessibility, and runtime QA workflow for Granite Edge AI.

interface.shortDescription: Redesign WinUI 3 surfaces without changing backend behaviour
interface.longDescription: A WinUI 3-native worker that routes design, XAML implementation, accessibility, runtime visual QA, and release gating through a one-writer workflow. Production UI edits are disabled until the repository implementation lock is explicitly opened.
defaultPrompt: Initialise and verify the Granite Native Frontend Worker v2. Do not implement UI.
Audit a WinUI 3 screen and prepare a redesign specification without editing production code.
